meta_title: Paul Wilkinson Garden & Ponds | Leeds Landscaping
meta_description: Paul Wilkinson Garden & Ponds in Leeds. Expert garden design, pond installation, and maintenance. Bespoke outdoor spaces. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Award-Winning Garden Design — Ponds & Water Features
hero_subhead: Expert pond installation, garden landscaping, and bespoke design. Create the garden you've always wanted with Paul Wilkinson's trusted local team.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Pond Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From bespoke pond design to full garden landscaping and ongoing maintenance, we handle every aspect of your outdoor space.

services.title: Pond Installation & Design
services.desc: Bespoke pond creation including wildlife ponds, koi pools, and decorative water features. We handle excavation, filtration, planting, and finishing touches to bring your vision to life.

services.title: Garden Landscaping
services.desc: Complete garden redesign with hard landscaping, planting schemes, pathways, and patios. We transform overgrown spaces into beautiful, usable outdoor areas tailored to your lifestyle.

services.title: Pond Maintenance & Repairs
services.desc: Regular cleaning, filter servicing, and plant care keep your pond healthy year-round. We also repair leaks, replace liners, and treat water quality issues quickly.

services.title: Decking & Patios
services.desc: Professionally installed timber decking and natural stone patios create perfect entertaining spaces. Finished to the highest standard and built to last.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert plant selection and border design that thrive in Leeds' climate. We choose shrubs, perennials, and specimen plants that provide colour and structure year after year.

services.title: Fencing & Garden Screening
services.desc: Durable fencing, trellising, and screening solutions that enhance privacy and define garden boundaries. Built tough to withstand Yorkshire weather.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. Mine's about creating spaces where families make memories.
about_para_1: Paul Wilkinson has spent over 20 years designing and building gardens across Leeds and West Yorkshire. From small courtyard gardens to ambitious landscaping projects, Paul combines practical expertise with genuine passion for outdoor spaces. His reputation for attention to detail and honest pricing has earned him hundreds of repeat customers and referrals.
about_para_2: Paul understands that your garden is an extension of your home—a place to relax, entertain, and connect with nature. He listens carefully to what you want, asks the right questions, and delivers results that exceed expectations. Whether you need a complete overhaul or specialist pond work, you'll work with someone who takes pride in every project and backs his work with a satisfaction guarantee.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Gardeners Say About Paul Wilkinson

reviews.text: Paul transformed our tatty back garden into something we actually use now. He listened to what we wanted, came up with clever design ideas we hadn't thought of, and the workmanship is brilliant. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had Paul install a wildlife pond for us last year. It's thriving now with frogs and newts. He explained everything as he went, kept the site tidy, and his prices were fair. Will definitely be using him again for the front garden.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Top bloke. Came round, gave us honest advice about what would and wouldn't work with our space, and did a cracking job with the patio and planting scheme. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend to anyone in Leeds.
reviews.author: James K.
